'''Max Ventures and Industries Limited''' is an Indian [[public company]] of [[Max Group]], headquartered in [[New Delhi]], [[India]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/max-india-to-divest-entire-stake-in-pharmax-to-group-firm-for-rs-61-crore/article28185782.ece |title=Max India to divest entire stake in Pharmax to group firm for Rs 61 crore |publisher=The Hindu BusinessLine |date=2019-06-27 |accessdate=2020-05-01}}</ref> It is the [[holding company]] for the group's real estate business, Max Estates.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/property-/-cstruction/max-estates-forms-jv-with-new-york-life-for-noida-realty-project/articleshow/74110148.cms?from=mdr|title=Max Estates forms JV with New York Life for Noida realty project|first=Arun|last=Kumar|date=13 February 2020|newspaper=The Economic Times}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/max-group-completes-rs-600-cr-office-building-in-noida-eyes-rs-70-cr-rental-a-year-119041400302_1.html|title=Max Group completes Rs 600 cr office building in Noida, eyes Rs 70 cr rental a year|agency=Press Trust of India|date=14 April 2019|via=Business Standard}}</ref>

==Subsidiaries==

===Max Estates===
Max Estates Limited, established in 2016, is a real estate developer focused on the Delhi NCR region and serves as the real estate arm of the $4 billion Max Group. It is a 100% subsidiary of the publicly listed Max Ventures and Industries Limited (MVIL). The company develops both commercial and residential properties, guided by its "LiveWell" design philosophies.

As of 2026, its portfolio of completed projects includes Grade A+ commercial spaces such as Max Towers (Noida), Max House (New Delhi), and Max Square (Noida), alongside 222 Rajpur, a residential community in Dehradun. Max Estates is also developing several luxury residential and mixed-use communities, including Estate 128 and Estate 105 in Noida, as well as Estate 360, Estate 361, and the Max District in Gurugram.

Financially, the company reported ₹5,305 Crore in FY26 pre-sales. In recognition of its environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives, Max Estates holds a dual 5-star GRESB sustainability rating across its segments.

== Max Estates ==
Max Estates Limited, established in 2016, is a real estate developer focused on the Delhi NCR region and serves as the real estate arm of the $4 billion Max Group. It is a 100% subsidiary of the publicly listed Max Ventures and Industries Limited (MVIL) and trades independently on the BSE and NSE under the ticker MAXESTATES. The company develops both commercial and residential properties, guided by its "LiveWell" and "WorkWell" design philosophies.

As of 2026, its portfolio of completed projects includes Grade A+ commercial spaces such as Max Towers (Noida), Max House (New Delhi), and Max Square (Noida), alongside 222 Rajpur, a residential community in Dehradun. Max Estates is also developing several luxury residential and mixed-use communities, including Estate 128 and Estate 105 in Noida, as well as Estate 360, Estate 361, and the Max District in Gurugram. 

Financially, the company reported ₹5,305 Crore in FY26 pre-sales. In recognition of its environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives, Max Estates holds a dual 5-star GRESB sustainability rating across its residential and commercial segments.
